name: Moriyama Yuka
source: The youngest Lakers member. She is the manager of the soccer club to which Akira Daidōji belongs. She has a strong liking for Akira Daidōji, but perhaps because it is so apparent, she is almost attacked by other members of the soccer club as a result. Compared to the other members, she has nothing particular regarding combat.
